Q1: Should this issue add its own fix to `gh_retry`'s replay in `scripts/gh_helpers.sh`, even though #9246, #9264, #9267 and #9283 already target the same failure?
Choices:
A) No code change. Treat this issue as a duplicate of the open fix. Once one of #9246, #9264, #9267 or #9283 merges, re-run CI on #9271 and close this issue without a plan or PR. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Fix it here anyway. Change only the success path of `gh_retry` (`scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1226-1231`) so that output that cannot be delivered to a closed reader returns a non-zero status whichever `cat` the host has. Keep the "do not re-run a successful command" rule, and leave `test_closed_reader_does_not_rerun_a_successful_command` as it is. This will probably conflict with #9264, #9267 and #9283.
C) Fix it here and also close the duplicate PRs #9264, #9267 and #9283 in the same change, so only one `gh_retry` fix lands.
**Note:** A means nothing for the plan or implement phases to do, so the pipeline will end at this issue. B and C both produce a PR that touches `scripts/gh_helpers.sh`.
